name: fleet-dm
command: id=$FLEET_NAME; [ -n "$id" ] || id=$(cat "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.fleet-identity" 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$id" ] && exec fleet "$id" tail dm || echo "fleet plugin: no identity (FLEET_NAME unset, no .fleet-identity in the project root): no private-message feed"
description: Fleet chat: private messages to this session's identity (one message per notification, a long one as continuation lines; act on each)

name: fleet-chan
command: id=$FLEET_NAME; [ -n "$id" ] || id=$(cat "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.fleet-identity" 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$id" ] && exec fleet "$id" tail chan || echo "fleet plugin: no identity (FLEET_NAME unset, no .fleet-identity in the project root): no room feed"
description: Fleet chat: every room (one message per notification, a long one as continuation lines; act only when `to` names this session's identity)
